dts.instance.ready.evidence: API 23345 returns the instance associated with the required scalar dtsJobId. RUNNING means usable; frozen, refunding, canceling and released states cannot satisfy readiness. Deployment and renewal remain pending.

dts.job.finished.evidence: API 23345 requires scalar dtsJobId and documents FINISH as the target job state, PAUSE as abnormal operation and PRECHECKFAILURE as a failed precheck. Intermediate module completion is not overall job completion.

dts.job.prechecked.evidence: API 23345 requires scalar dtsJobId and documents PRECHECKPASS as the target job state, PAUSE as abnormal operation and PRECHECKFAILURE as a failed precheck. Intermediate module completion is not overall job completion.

dts.job.stopped.evidence: API 23345 requires scalar dtsJobId and documents STOP as the target job state, PAUSE as abnormal operation and PRECHECKFAILURE as a failed precheck. Intermediate module completion is not overall job completion.

dts.legacy.job.finished.evidence: API 9699 documents FINISH in the job status enum. Its request requires a job ID or instance ID. No failure meaning is documented for this legacy enum, so other states remain bounded and pending.

dts.precheck.completed.evidence: API 23317 requires scalar dtsJobId and documents the precheck module states DONE (complete), FAIL (failed), and STOP (paused). INIT, STARTING, RUNNING and RETRY remain pending.
